photos.file: A Maasai Giraffe the Tallest Animal in Kenya with Britam Tower the tallest building in Kenya in the background at Nairobi National Park.jpg
photos.desc: The photo shows a Maasai giraffe, the tallest animal in Kenya with the Britam Tower the tallest building and Kenya Commercial Bank Plaza (KCB Plaza) the 8th tallest buildings in Kenya in the backgroun

The giraffe (Giraffa camelopardalis) is an African even-toed ungulate mammal, the tallest of all land-living animal species, and the largest ruminant. It is covered in large, irregular patches of yell
